You can now programmatically create accounts with QuickSight Enterprise and Enterprise + Q editions. For more information, visit here. ...

rows.title: Rolling dates in filters and parameters
rows.summary: You can now set a rolling date on date range fiters and relative date parameters in analyses. For more information, see Creating range date filters in analyses and Setting up parameters.
rows.quote: | [Rolling dates in filters and parameters](#doc-history) | You can now set a rolling date on date range fiters and relative date parameters in analyses. For more information, see [Creating range date filters in analyses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/add-a-date-filter2.html#create-date-filter-analyses) and [Setting up parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/parameters-set-up). | July 5, 2022 |

rows.title: Calculations update
rows.summary: You can now create level-aware calculations in QuickSight. You can specify at what level to group computations using level-aware calculation - aggregation (LAC-A) functions. You can also specify the window or partition to compute a calculation using level-aware calculation - window (LAC-W) functions (previously known as level-aware aggregations). For more information, see Using level-aware calculations.

rows.title: Allowed domains
rows.summary: Developers can now add a domain at run-time to an allow list with the AllowedDomains parameter of a GenerateEmbedUrlForAnonymousUser or a GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser API call. For more information, see Allow listing domains at run-time with the QuickSight API.

rows.title: Account provisioning
rows.summary: You can now sign up for an Amazon QuickSight account with the Amazon QuickSight API. For more information, see CreateAccountSubscription.
